purpose: Present a deliberate decision about an action.
keywords: Dictionary-form / ない-form verb + ことにする.
I decided to walk every morning.
I have decided not to go out today.
Let us decide to hold the meeting online.
Foreground a choice or report an arrangement
formation: Dictionary-form / ない-form verb + ことにする.
restrictions: Focuses on the decision-maker’s choice; habitual ことにしている describes a personal rule.
mistake: Distinguish choosing an action from reporting an externally framed arrangement.
